title: Wong Vung Da

page_data.en:
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

November 11th 1916

Sir,
General Loo of Woosung sent one of his officers
to the Arsenal on 9th instant to urge General Yang
to give him money to pay the Woosung troops whose
wages are ten days overdue.
Eight hundred piculs of rice has arrived at
the Arsenal from Wuhu for the use of the troops.
All local officials will visit the home of the
late Huang Hsin to-day to offer their condolences.
It is reported that some enemies of Zee
Kou Liang, Chief of Shanghai Woosung Police and
the relatives of Chinese who were killed or
injured in the North Szechsun Road shooting affray
intend to petition the Government regarding
the incident.

Your Obedient Servant,

Detective Sub Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
page_data.zh:
上海工部局。

（印：上海工部局）
警务处，
（侦探科）

1916年11月11日

先生：
本月9日，吴淞的卢将军派遣其一名军官前往兵工厂，催促杨将军向其提供款项，以支付吴淞部队已拖欠十日的军饷。
已有八百担大米从芜湖运抵兵工厂，供部队使用。
今日，所有本地官员将前往已故黄兴府上吊唁。
据报，上海吴淞警察局局长恽古良（音译）的一些政敌，以及在北四川路枪击事件中伤亡中国人的亲属，拟就该事件向政府请愿。

您顺从的仆人，

侦探副督察。

警务总监。

page_data.en:
Form 2    31
Shanghai Municipal Police.
Central Police    Station.
November    14th    1916.
REPORT ON Newspaper report re Petition of Relatives of Victims in
North Szechuen Road Shooting Affray.
Made by D. S. Givens.    Forwarded by
Sir,
I beg to report that Wong Vung Dau (王文涛) is a native of
Anhwei. He is a member of the Kuomintang party and unemployed.
he is one of the promoters of the Liberal Party with which
Kidner's interpreter is prominently connected. Wong had
a son aged eight killed, and a son and a daughter injured in
the North Szechuen Road shooting affray.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
D.S.Givens
Detective Sergeant.
Kinney. C.I.
for Chief Detective Inspector.
See Min Kuo Pao    11:11:'16
page_data.zh:
表格 2    31
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
中央巡捕房。
1916年11月14日。
关于北四川路枪击事件受害者亲属请愿之报纸报道的报告。
由 D. S. Givens 撰写。呈送
先生：
谨此报告，王文涛（Wong Vung Dau）系安徽人。他是国民党党员，目前无业。他是自由党的发起人之一，金尼尔（Kidner）的翻译与该党关系密切。王有一子（八岁）在北四川路枪击事件中丧生，另有一子一女受伤。
先生，我是
您顺从的仆人，
D.S.Givens
侦探警长。
Kinney. C.I.
代首席侦探督察。
参见《民国日报》 1916年11月11日
